rows.source: UKHSA leprosy diagnosis, notification and control
rows.verified: Leprosy is a curable chronic infection caused mainly by Mycobacterium leprae.

rows.source: UKHSA leprosy diagnosis, notification and control
rows.verified: Leprosy primarily affects skin, respiratory mucosa, eyes and peripheral nerves.

rows.source: UKHSA leprosy diagnosis, notification and control
rows.verified: Early diagnosis and multidrug therapy can cure disease and prevent disability.

rows.source: UKHSA leprosy diagnosis, notification and control
rows.verified: The incubation period can range from about 6 months to 20 years or longer.

rows.source: UKHSA leprosy diagnosis, notification and control
rows.verified: Clinical suspicion should increase for chronic non-itchy skin patches with altered sensation or peripheral-nerve damage after residence in an endemic area.

rows.source: UKHSA leprosy diagnosis, notification and control
rows.verified: Diagnosis should be confirmed microscopically or histologically with specialist advice.

rows.source: UKHSA leprosy diagnosis, notification and control
rows.verified: Leprosy is statutorily notifiable in England to support prompt detection, treatment and surveillance.

rows.source: UKHSA leprosy diagnosis, notification and control
rows.verified: WHO-recommended multidrug therapy rapidly reduces viable bacilli, and treated patients can quickly become non-infectious.

rows.source: UKHSA leprosy diagnosis, notification and control
rows.verified: Leprosy risk and presentation depend on organism burden, disease type, endemic exposure, incubation, host immunity, diagnosis and treatment timing.

rows.source: UKHSA leprosy diagnosis, notification and control
rows.verified: UKHSA leprosy evidence is patient-, exposure-, disease-, diagnostic-, treatment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.

rows.source: OPSS children's fancy-dress costume safety
rows.verified: OPSS tested 128 children's Halloween costumes purchased from online marketplaces.

rows.source: OPSS children's fancy-dress costume safety
rows.verified: More than 80% of the targeted costumes failed at least one basic safety test.

rows.source: OPSS children's fancy-dress costume safety
rows.verified: Testing included flammability, cord and drawstring hazards and labelling compliance.

rows.source: OPSS children's fancy-dress costume safety
rows.verified: Products were assessed against the Toys (Safety) Regulations 2011 and relevant standards.

rows.source: OPSS children's fancy-dress costume safety
rows.verified: Platforms removed the tested products that failed the safety assessment.

rows.source: OPSS children's fancy-dress costume safety
rows.verified: OPSS advises buying costumes from trusted sources.

rows.source: OPSS children's fancy-dress costume safety
rows.verified: Children in fancy dress should be kept away from fires and open flames.

rows.source: OPSS children's fancy-dress costume safety
rows.verified: Long head or neck cords can create strangulation or entrapment hazards.

rows.source: OPSS children's fancy-dress costume safety
rows.verified: Fancy-dress risk depends on product design, fabric, cords, labelling, compliance, seller, child age, supervision and proximity to flame.

rows.source: OPSS children's fancy-dress costume safety
rows.verified: OPSS costume-test evidence is targeted-product-, marketplace-, test-, child-, use- and time-specific and is not a national non-compliance estimate or parcel-level injury probability.
